about: Assessment conditions of the skills assessors that are not registration bodies (engineering, IT, accounting, VETASSESS general/professional). Every value quotes the assessor's own page; VETASSESS group and Pathway 1 are per occupation, from each occupation's page on vetassess.com.au. IML (manager occupations) criteria are per occupation, from each occupation's Assessment Criteria PDF on managersandleaders.com.au.

pathways.value: Accredited qualification (Australian, Washington, Sydney or Dublin Accord) can use that pathway; otherwise the competency demonstration report (CDR) pathway
pathways.quote: If your qualification is accredited, you can choose between four assessment pathways or types: Australian qualification Washington Accord Dublin Accord Sydney Accord

australianPathway.value: Australian qualification pathway needs a program accredited by Engineers Australia, started during or after the year accreditation commenced
australianPathway.quote: You can apply via the Australian qualification pathway if: your program is accredited by Engineers Australia , and you started your program during or after the year of accreditation commencement.

accordFull.value: Accord recognition needs the program listed as fully accredited; provisional accreditation is not enough
accordFull.quote: Your program is listed as fully accredited, provisional accreditation isn’t sufficient.

cdrWhen.value: CDR pathway for non-accredited or provisionally accredited qualifications, or an occupation different from the accredited qualification title
cdrWhen.quote: You should apply via the competency demonstration report (CDR) assessment pathway if you: have a provisionally-accredited Australian qualification have an engineering qualification that is not accredited are seeking to be assessed for an engineering occupation that differs from your accredited qualification title

cdrContent.quote: For your assessment, you’ll need to provide three written career episodes. In each episode, explain how you developed and demonstrated the entry-to-practice (Stage 1) competencies listed for your specific occupational category. You must be able to demonstrate all 16 elements of competency at least once across your three career episodes.

minQualification.value: AQF Level 6 (Advanced Diploma / Associate Degree) minimum
minQualification.quote: The minimum academic qualification suitable for assessment by Engineers Australia is AQF Level 6 – Advanced Diploma, Associate Degree.

value.validity: taken within three years before lodging

englishExempt.value: No test needed after two academic years (at least 92 weeks) at a CRICOS-registered institution at AQF level 6+, or with a UK/US/Canada/NZ/Ireland passport
englishExempt.quote: Have successfully graduated from an Australian institution with two academic years of study, comprised of at least 92 weeks in a CRICOS-registered institution at Australian Qualifications Framework (AQF) level 6 and above.

managerRSEA.value: Relevant Skilled Employment Assessment is mandatory for Engineering Manager
managerRSEA.quote: Note: Relevant Skilled Employment Assessment is mandatory if you are applying to be assessed as Engineering Manager.

noEnglish.value: ACS does not require an English test
